name: Spring Career Mixer
text: Spring Career Mixer on March 4, 2027 in Ronald Tutor Campus Center 450 (already booked). About 80 students. Free catering from USC Hospitality $800 and room rental $400, quotes attached. Requesting $1,200 from USG. USG has funded 1 of our events this semester, $1,500 total this year.

name: Hackathon Kickoff Night
text: Hackathon Kickoff Night on Feb 3, 2027 in Seeley G. Mudd 101 (not booked yet). About 150 students. Free catering from USC Hospitality $1,600 and room rental $1,200, quotes attached. Asking USG for $2,800. USG has funded 2 of our events this semester, $4,200 total this year. We heard USG funds are running low.

name: Diwali Night
text: Diwali Night on Dec 12 in the TCC Grand Ballroom (not booked yet), about 300 people. We'll sell tickets and sell food from a local restaurant, plus a DJ and dancing. Asking USG for $3,500. Costs: ballroom $4,500, DJ $600, no quotes yet. USG has funded 4 of our events this semester, $5,200 total this year.
